body:
I'm a no on a 5% burn per week (we currently have a 1 week spend period), but would be a yes on a 1% burn per week or two weeks (targeting ~2.5% burn per month) at this point.

Long term, I think using the treasury aggressively for BD is one of the most effective moves that Edgeware could make, but I'd be interested in hearing more in the way of proposals from the people working on that.

I basically think the treasury could be far more effective than existing 1st/2nd-gen chains (Dash, Decred, etc.) once smart contracts and XCMP are working.
